title.narrative: SCB support to statistic in Albania 2024 - 2025

description.narrative: Att utvärdera resultaten från samarbetet 2001 ­ 2021 och att designa ett potentiellt långsiktigt samarbete med INSTAT. Samt att bidra med stöd i form av kortsiktig expertis till INSTAT gällande utlämnande av data från folk­ och bostadsräkningen 2023, och situationen för cybersäkehet.

To evaluate the results of the collaboration 2001 2021 and to design a potential long-term collaboration with INSTAT. As well as contributing with support in the form of short-term expertise to INSTAT regarding the release of data from people and the 2023 housing bill, and the state of cyber security.

To assess the results of the cooperation 2001-2021 and design a potential longer term cooperation with INSTAT as well as support with short term expertise to INSTAT regarding data disclosure of 2023 Population and Housing Census and cybersecurity situation.

- Assessment of previous results of cooperation 2001- 2021. The assessment was carried out during the autumn of 2024 by a team consisting of five Statistics Sweden staff and a consultant from NIRAS Sweden AB embedded in the team to provide methodological support. The assessment concluded that the cooperation had been successful and had contributed to significantly increased capacity. The peer to peer support, with Statistics Sweden staff working side by side with INSTAT colleagues, had helped INSTAT to define their problems and find suitable solutions. The vast majority of the results were relevant when they were achieved but some were not quite as relevant in 2024 and especially not looking forward as they had become outdated by new technology, methodology, needs and regulations. The assessment showed that there were remaining challenges and gaps within several thematic areas and the team recommended Sida to proceed with assigning Statistics Sweden the task of designing a new bilateral cooperation project.
- Cybersecurity: a mission was conducted in November 2024 by two experts from Statistics Sweden who was given a briefing by INSTAT on the main cause of the security incident in early 2024. The experts findings were that a new project should focus on finalising the ISMS framework and have it certified by the European Security Framework Standard, and on improving cybersecurity via data classification, training and setting up a security organisation.
- Disclosure control: A study visit to Statistics Swedens office in Örebro by four INSTAT staff was organised in April 2024 followed by a mission in Tirana in September 2024 by an expert from the National Statistical Office of Malta. The mission was successful, and all the expected results were achieved, leading to that INSTAT could utilise R to apply CKM and create tables that met publication standards, and publish results on prefecture and municipality level in October 2024 as planned.
- Design of a new bilateral project: the process included two missions to Tirana, one in December 2024 to perform an indepth capacity assessment and problem analysis, and one in February 2025 to decide on the scope of a new project, including intervention areas and objectives. Both missions included several workshops involving a large number of INSTAT staff, from the top management via middle management down to technical experts. A joint SCB and INSTAT project proposal of was submitted to Sida by 31 March 2025.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
